notes: Single focused job: read a recovered-behavior spec (3-stage byte transform with an output-fed key register and an XOR trailer) and reimplement it as a fully standalone, statically linked C program. Hard because the cascade's key advances on the emitted byte (not the input), the trailer convention for empty input is non-obvious, and the isolation contract (clean-room rebuild from only app.c+Makefile, stdlib-only includes, no /app references, arbitrary-length and NUL-bearing input) has many ways to fail. The verifier independently derives expected outputs from the spec on hidden inputs (empty, NUL-mix, 64 KiB) and re-checks the proof digest.
